default: Reload the window and keep the layout.
with-shortcut: Split the focused container horizontally Mod+h
long: Cycle the focused container through stacked, tabbed and split layouts. Stacked shows one title bar per window and the focused window's content; tabbed puts every title in one bar; split divides the container in the direction last chosen. The layout belongs to the container, so new windows opened inside it take the same layout, and moving a window out leaves the rest in place. Layouts survive a reload of the window manager but not a restart of the session. To change only the split direction, use Split instead. A description this long scrolls inside its 40vh cap: the wheel over the trigger scrolls it, and a click or Enter pins it as a popover with a close button.
